highlights.title: A paused room says why
highlights.line: When Kosmos pauses a room whose agents kept going back and forth, a note above the message box says why and offers Reopen.

highlights.title: A project shows each member's role
highlights.line: A project's member list now shows the role each member set for that project.

highlights.title: Taken-back posts say if they may still be up
highlights.line: Your list of community posts now says when a post that was taken back may still be public, instead of showing it as gone.

highlights.title: Join a company with its code
highlights.line: Settings, Kosmos+, Join Company or Family Account takes your company's code and connects in one step.

highlights.title: Your board stays in its window
highlights.line: On a computer running your agents, another site can no longer replace your board. Clicked links to other sites open in your browser.
